name: jobs-conestoga
eval: (() => { const g = d.grt; if (!g) return { c: [-4400, -5150, 30], t: [-4370, -5110, 0] }; const v = g.buses[0]; for (const b of g.buses) b.group.visible = true; d.player.x = v.x - 30; d.player.z = v.z; const f = v.forward; return { c: [v.x + f.x * 30 - f.z * 22, v.z + f.z * 30 + f.x * 22, 14], t: [v.x, v.z, 1], fov: 55 }; })()

name: jobs-sign
eval: (() => { const g = d.grt; if (!g) return { c: [-4400, -5150, 3], t: [-4370, -5110, 2] }; const rt = g.routes[0], v = g.buses[0]; for (const b of g.buses) b.group.visible = true; d.player.x = v.x - 30; d.player.z = v.z; if (!g.run) g.start(rt, v); const f = v.forward; return { c: [v.x + f.x * 13 - f.z * 4.5, v.z + f.z * 13 + f.x * 4.5, 2.6], t: [v.x + f.x * 5, v.z + f.z * 5, 2.2], fov: 50 }; })()
